description: This Python source file contains functions for transforming and processing role, competency, and learning resource data in a career pathway navigator project. It includes mappings for skill levels, building seed data for roles and competencies, parsing scores, creating relationship records, and extracting learning resources from a navigator data frame.

methods.name: Optional[str] normalize_level(level_raw: str)
methods.description: Maps raw skill level strings into standardized categories: 'beginner', 'intermediate', or 'advanced'.

methods.name: Tuple[List[Dict],List[Dict],List[Dict]] build_from_competency_mapping( mapping_df: pd.DataFrame, limit: Optional[int] = None )
methods.description: Builds seed rows for competencies, roles, and role associations from a mapping DataFrame.

methods.name: List[Dict] build_roles_from_cards( role_cards: Iterable[Dict[str, str]], existing_roles: Optional[Iterable[str]] = None, )
methods.description: Creates role seed records from role card text dictionaries, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: Optional[float] _parse_score(value)
methods.description: Converts various score representations into a float, handling percentages and fractions.

methods.name: List[Dict] build_role_adjacency_records( adjacency_df: pd.DataFrame, limit: Optional[int] = None )
methods.description: Generates role adjacency records based on a DataFrame with optional score parsing.

methods.name: List[Dict] attach_ids_for_relationships( role_competencies: List[Dict], role_name_to_id: Dict[str, int], competency_name_to_id: Dict[str, int], )
methods.description: Converts role/competency name associations into ID-based relational records.

methods.name: List[Dict] attach_ids_for_role_adjacency( role_adjacency: List[Dict], role_name_to_id: Dict[str, int], )
methods.description: Converts role name adjacencies into ID-based relational records.

methods.name: List[Dict] build_learning_resources_from_navigator( navigator_df: Optional[pd.DataFrame], limit: Optional[int] = None )
methods.description: Extracts learning resource links from a navigator DataFrame into structured resource records.
